public_gates: split M496 targeted pairs by config
run decision-window wrong-history outcome gates on both M494 configs
use early offsets 0 2 4 8 around the matched decision point
report wrong-history proof rows, event rows, reset controls, zero-current controls, label/seed/target/config diversity
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not use hidden-hold variants as deployable proof
do not count aggregate behavior smoke as self-ID proof
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: Early decision-window wrong-history interventions on the M496 targeted natural belief surface can reveal whether pre-reveal command-response belief affects outcomes before current-response correction dominates.
success_criteria: outcome gate runs complete for both configs
combined summary reports wrong_tail_once proof and event rows
combined summary reports reset_tail and zero_current_tail controls
result is classified as positive proof, no-effect, or control-only sensitivity
failure_criteria: either config gate fails to run
too many pairs are invalid because requested snapshots are missing
summary cannot separate wrong-history from reset/zero-current controls
training or checkpoint promotion is performed

commands.name: split_targeted_pairs
commands.command: Split runs/m496_natural_belief_targeted_pair_triage/targeted_pairs.csv by config into short_reveal and warmup_capability files.

commands.name: short_reveal_decision_window_gate
commands.command: Run tail_aligned_wrong_history_gate on the short_reveal split with tail_offsets 0,2,4,8 and env config configs/m494_natural_belief_short_reveal_zero_relvel.json.

commands.name: warmup_capability_decision_window_gate
commands.command: Run tail_aligned_wrong_history_gate on the warmup_capability split with tail_offsets 0,2,4,8 and env config configs/m494_natural_belief_warmup_capability_zero_relvel.json.

commands.name: combined_outcome_summary
commands.command: Summarize wrong-history outcome proof rows and reset/zero-current controls across configs.

decision_rule: M497 should admit a proof expansion only if wrong-history outcome rows are source-diverse and include event rows; if only controls degrade, classify as control-only sensitivity and audit no-effect.
